our_interpretation: Assess Marcus’s side of the wager: fewer than eight qualifying tasks by the deadline. Do not infer a numerical confidence from the stakes.
The conditional donation wording defines the wager’s outcomes, rather than a separate antecedent that must occur before assessing the capability forecast.
The agreed panel determines task success, acceptable tailoring and reasonable costs. The stated cost figures are illustrative, not strict caps imposed by this assessment.
Technical feasibility by the deadline counts even without an actual attempt. The panel may publish its decision after the deadline.
Donation amounts are stakes, not company financial metrics.
criteria.support_condition: The mutually agreed panel determines that fewer than eight of the ten specified tasks were technically feasible by December 31, 2027, under the bet’s cost, tailoring and system constraints.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The mutually agreed panel determines that at least eight of the ten specified tasks were technically feasible by December 31, 2027, under those constraints.
